meaning: Observe finite direct Operation-to-provider calls without replacing original generated behavior or treating static imports as execution proof.

relations: factory instance creates original owned return
parent argument refers to earlier owned return
plain Enum repeats the same singleton
Event argument refers to captured slot clock
exclusions: transitive dependency calls are not direct Operation calls
method facade is not an original product factory
test observation is not production effect or public coverage

direct_scope: Operation provider imports only: guard calls, selected factory constructors/create, sum create and plain Enum fromVariant, Event constructor; original Event/Operation wrapper-provider identity. Internal factory Rule/owned-value and sum normalize/key interactions remain obligations of the existing independent families, not covered by this direct protocol.
initialization: Fresh original closure per Operation. Load dependencies before target provider, install only export facades, capture original factory calls during target provider load. One source-ordered child-before-parent instance per selected cached record adapter. Preserve original returned factory and receiver behind facade; factory methods other than create remain original and receive no execution permission.
calls: Direct calls only while target execute is active; nested method calls during a direct original call are excluded explicitly. Compare exact ordered provider, method, arity, factory instance, argument data views and original return/error. Argument descriptors must remain unchanged. Setup is separate from every finite case.
identity: Original record/sum returns have unique identity linked to the case and direct-call ordinal; reusing an earlier return fails. Plain Enum identity is provider+variant singleton across cases; all same-provider same-variant uses alias. Parent arguments encode references to these original returns. Raw structural arguments compare exact framed values and descriptor stability; raw-object alias topology is not claimed. Clock functions encode their exact captured fixture slot identity, never merely the returned time.
returns: Guard boolean; factory original ok/failure_codes and owned fields; sum/Enum original owned typed value; Event original frozen occurrence data or exact error. Original component isOwned checks and inert descriptor inspection are observer work with capture suppressed. No hash/key/getter is called while serializing arguments. Preserve existing Operation outcome/fixture observations independently, including await order and uncertainty.
fixtures: Reuse all complete finite source-derived Operation cases and interned data recipes. The source reference independently computes direct calls from typed values, guards, selected validator bindings and Event contracts; native payload contains no expected answers. Construction/fixture helpers never grant production ports.
coverage: All source Operation rows retained. Applicable direct runtime edges identified by exact module occurrence; only rows with complete finite witnesses can become ready. Empty/unavailable cases or capacity exhaustion are not_evaluable for the whole family. At least a complete commit/preparation witness required; original invalid and rejected samples remain. Source case enumeration does not prove universal satisfiability.
acceptance: Exact source bindings and both original wrapper identities
Independent initialization and per-case direct call observations
Original semantic fixture outcome/trace remains unchanged
Compound real records/VO/Enums/sums and repeated Event slots; scalar and Enum-only cases
Strict-compiling duplicate/missing/wrong-provider calls rejected even when final values match
Separate source/native audits and retained artifact/tool execution currentness before full Operation qualification
claim_ceiling: Finite instrumented direct-call evidence. No transitive-edge pass, raw-object alias proof, uninstrumented equivalence, public aggregation, default change, release, admission or authority. Whole R08ae11 remains incomplete until retained execution also passes.
